request.description: Original Pulp Wars chunky clean 2D strategy-game illustration, playful board-game sticker, strong dark colored outline, mostly flat colors, two-level cel shading, minimal texture, simple highlight, intentionally drawn rather than rendered, charming silly adventurous tone. Palette: muted blue-green #589198, pale desaturated aqua highlights, dark teal low-contrast troughs. Square-grid terrain material: an exact 256 by 256 full square of calm shallow blue-green WATER viewed straight downward. Fill the complete canvas with continuous water. Show exactly three broad, low-contrast, gently curved horizontal ripple bands: one crossing the upper-left edge, one crossing through the middle, and one crossing the lower-right edge. The bands are part of the water surface, not separate objects. Quiet flat two-tone illustrated shading with northwest light, no focal subject and no centered pattern. Deterministic processing smooths minor quantization and converges the outer 32 pixels to the shared shallow edge field. Must not include: pixel-art grid, detailed pixel art, photorealism, painterly brushwork, realistic anatomy, realistic lighting, faux 3D, low-poly 3D, gradients, complex ambient light, tiny texture, intricate costume, scenery, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI frame, selection ring, health bar, cast shadow, ground plane, matte, halo, cropped silhouette, blur, gore; character, astronaut, robot, person, flag, landscape, field, ground, moon, pixel-art scene, dark outline around ripple, bean shape, crescent object, isolated motif, centered radial pattern, land, coast, beach, foam border, route, current arrow, grid, selection, ownership, fog, bubbles, whitecaps, tiny noise, photoreal reflection, horizon, fish, pearls, boat, port, text, UI, directional gradient, frame, bevel, transparent corner.
